title: Miso aubergine and tofu rice bowl
summary: Aubergine and firm tofu glazed with rice miso, served with pak choi and a small bowl of rice. Vegan if your miso is rice miso, not barley.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Score the aubergine flesh in a criss-cross, brush with half the rapeseed oil and roast, cut side down, for 15 minutes.
steps.tip: Scoring lets the miso get into the flesh instead of sitting on the skin.

steps.instruction: Stir the miso, tamari and ginger with a teaspoon of hot water. Turn the aubergine, spread on half the glaze and roast until soft.
Meanwhile cook the rice in 180 g of water. Fry the tofu in the remaining rapeseed oil until golden, then brush with the rest of the glaze.
In the same pan, wilt the pak choi with a splash of water and the sesame oil. Serve the aubergine and tofu over rice with the greens and spring onion.
Spoon any glaze left in the tin over the top. Rice miso is salty, so taste before adding any extra tamari.
